# KartUI style reference

One scoped `style { ... }` block is allowed in a component/layout. Selectors:
`panel`, `label`, `image`, `button`, `list`, or one `.class`. Element rule first,
then the element's single class. No descendant selectors, selector lists,
cascade, CSS variables, per-side box model, or arbitrary CSS. Values can use
matching `theme.*` tokens. Colors are `#RRGGBB`/`#RRGGBBAA`; numeric values are
integer logical pixels, usually 0–2048.

| Property | Target | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `background` | panel/button/list | color |
| `background-hover`, `background-focus`, `background-pressed`, `background-disabled` | button/list | color; direct state form (pseudo-selectors are preferred) |
| `color` | label/button/list | color |
| `color-hover`, `color-focus`, `color-pressed`, `color-disabled` | button/list | color; direct state form (pseudo-selectors are preferred) |
| `background-image` | panel/button/list | `theme.images.name` |
| `background-image-hover`, `background-image-focus`, `background-image-pressed`, `background-image-disabled` | button/list | `theme.images.name`; direct state form |
| `padding`, `gap` | panel | integer |
| `flex-direction` | panel | `column`, `row` |
| `align-items` | panel | `start`, `center`, `end`, `stretch` |
| `justify-content` | panel | `start`, `center`, `end`, `space-between` |
| `overflow` | panel | `visible`, `scroll` |
| `position` | nested panel/control | `absolute` only |
| `left`, `right`, `top`, `bottom` | absolute nested panel/control | integer inset; paired insets stretch axis |
| `font-size` | label/button/list | integer |
| `font-family` | label/button/list | `body`, `display`, `mono` |
| `text-align` | label/button/list | `left`, `center`, `right` |
| `image` | image | `theme.images.name` |
| `image-fit` | image | `stretch`, `contain`, `cover` |
| `icon` | button/list | `theme.images.name` |
| `icon-position` | button/list | `start`, `end` |
| `icon-size`, `icon-gap` | button/list | integer |
| `tint` | image/button/list | color |
| `min-width`, `min-height`, `max-width`, `max-height` | panel/label/image/button/list | integer |
| `flex-grow` | panel/label/image/button/list | integer 0–16 |
| `margin` | panel/label/image/button/list | uniform integer 0–256 |
| `transition-duration`, `transition-delay` | root/panel/control where supported | milliseconds 0–2000 |
| `transition-easing` | root/panel/control where supported | `linear`, `ease-out`, `ease-in-out` |
| `transition-enter` | nested panel | `slide-from-left`, `slide-from-right`, `slide-from-top`, `slide-from-bottom` |
| `transition-exit` | nested panel | `slide-to-left`, `slide-to-right`, `slide-to-top`, `slide-to-bottom` |

## Control states

Buttons/lists use `:hover`, `:focus`, `:pressed`, `:disabled`; state rules allow
only `background`, `background-image`, and `color`.

```css
.primary { background: theme.colors.primary; color: theme.colors.text; }
.primary:hover { background: theme.colors.primary-hover; }
.primary:focus { background: theme.colors.focus; }
.primary:pressed { background: theme.colors.primary-pressed; }
.primary:disabled { background: theme.colors.disabled; color: theme.colors.text-disabled; }
```

Focus falls back to hover resources when omitted. State transition properties
crossfade at host draw cadence, never by running cartridge updates. Reduced
motion settles them immediately.

## Responsive and layout behavior

One `@media (max-width: N) { ... }` block per component is allowed, `N` =
240–1024 logical pixels. It may override the same rules. Multiple breakpoints,
`min-width`, orientation, nested media are rejected. `flex-grow` shares free
main-axis space by weight; `overflow: scroll` clips and retains scroll state by
component/panel identity. Touch dragging scrolls the smallest overflow panel
and suppresses click on release. Absolute overlays use parent padded content,
consume no flow space, and have no z-index. Text wrapping is not available in
SDK 0.11; constrain widths and keep labels short.
